assertions.name: m_n_matches_codata_within_10ppb
assertions.source: m_n via the parameter-free Kashiwara b² Q_β (n→p+e+ν̄) should match CODATA m_n within 10 ppb — observed ~1 ppb. TIER: near-match; exact Q_β gated on the s5bb Habiro keystone.

description: Production substrate-categorical prediction of m_p and m_n from (m_e, m_μ, q_0) using Lean-proved closed forms for |tr_M(β_Bor)| and [3]_q!. The neutron uses the 3-input chain m_n = m_p + Q_β + m_e with Q_β the parameter-free Kashiwara b² truncation (near-match, ~+1 ppb on m_n); the Hecke-skein flavor-split is a secondary ratio. CAL-3 (Q_β) is NOT used as input — Q_β becomes a DERIVED quantity. Substrate identity: m_p = 2·m_μ·|tr_M|·[3]_q!/q^3 - 12·m_e where the '12' is the Ocneanu cancellation reciprocal.

predictions_pathC.derivation: m_n = m_p + Q_β(Kashiwara b², parameter-free) + m_e
